title: The Hollowtext, Vol. III
author: Unknown Surveyor
pages:
Page 1 of the Hollowtext, as copied by the third expedition.

We found the star before we found the words for it. It did not fall. It was already here when the stone was young, and the stone grew wrong around it, the way skin grows wrong around a splinter.

Page 2.

It does not eat. It does not chase. It counts. Every eye that finds it, it keeps. We do not know what it does with the counting, only that the counted do not stay themselves for long.

Page 3.

The tall ones it sends up are not guards. They are its own eyes, walked out on legs it grew for them. Do not let them find your eyes. If they do, do not look away first - look away *last*, on your own terms, or it will close the distance for you.

Page 4.

The low ones hunt by ear and by flame-light. They forget you the moment you are quiet and dark. We have taken to calling the quiet the only mercy this place gives freely.

Page 5, final, water-damaged.

Three braziers, lit in haste, bought my brother a fragment of the thing's own light. I do not know if it was worth what answered instead. I am leaving this book at the altar for whoever is fool enough to follow. Do not linger. Do not stare back. Do not-
